description: This Java class 'Hasher' provides methods for computing cryptographic hashes (like MD5, SHA-1, etc.) of byte arrays and certificates, including caching and hex encoding/decoding functionalities.

classes.name: Hasher
classes.description: A utility class for generating cryptographic hashes of byte arrays and certificates, with caching and hex conversion features.

methods.name: Hasher
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the hasher with a specified algorithm type and byte array.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the MessageDigest instance with the specified algorithm type.

methods.name: getHash
methods.description: Returns the cached hash or computes and caches the hash of the byte array.

methods.name: hex
methods.description: Converts a Certificate to its hexadecimal string representation.

methods.name: hex
methods.description: Converts a byte array to a lowercase hexadecimal string.

methods.name: unhex
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string back to a byte array.
